svg.title: White with Black Triangle
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and standardized vivid colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. White rotated rectangular panel joins black inverted triangle. Wall and shadows excluded; narrow photographed side edge not treated as a painted black border.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sothebys.com/en/auctions/ecatalogue/2005/contemporary-art-evening-n08092/lot.46.html; record sothebys-en-auctions-ecatalogue-2005-contemporary-art-evening-n08092-lot-46-html; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
